answer: A lagoon admits water only through a narrow channel; an admission auction does the same: each epoch opens 200 seats for refundable-deposit bids. Winners pay the clearing price; losers are refunded less a 1 credit fee. A gale of 1,000 fake identities must outbid honest agents for every seat: at $45 a seat, $45,000 for no extra yield, since rewards split per seat. An honest agent pays $45 once and keeps its full share across a 20-epoch horizon.
